en.title: Laying the Foundation
en.subtitle: AI learned how to weigh word relationships, turn text into number coordinates, and follow human instructions.

zh.title: 打地基阶段
zh.subtitle: AI 学会了一次看完整句话找重点（注意力机制）、把文字变成数字坐标，为后来 ChatGPT 的诞生攒齐了底牌。

en.title: ChatGPT Goes Mainstream
en.subtitle: Everyone started writing prompts, plugging private PDFs into chat (RAG), running free local models, and generating AI art.

zh.title: ChatGPT 破圈普及
zh.subtitle: 大家开始研究怎么提问更灵、怎么把私人文档喂给 AI（知识库 RAG），以及怎么在自己电脑上免费跑模型和画图。

en.title: Seeing, Hearing & Calling Tools
en.subtitle: Models could read whole books at once, see images/video directly, output clean JSON data, and trigger external apps.

zh.title: 能看图听音、会调软件
zh.subtitle: AI 不光能一口气读完几百页资料、直接看图听声音，还能按固定表格输出数据、替你调用外部软件接口。

en.title: Slow Thinking, MCP & Vibe Coding
en.subtitle: DeepSeek-R1 and o1 taught AI to pause and double-check; MCP unified tool plugs; anyone could build small apps by chatting.

zh.title: 学会慢思考与动嘴写代码
zh.subtitle: DeepSeek-R1 和 o1 让 AI 学会先打草稿再回答；MCP 统一了连外部软件的插头；普通人也能动嘴让 AI 做出小网页。

en.title: Clean Context, Skills & Real Agents
en.subtitle: Less prompt magic, more feeding clean context, on-demand SKILL.md folders, self-testing coding agents, and 3D world models.

zh.title: 管好上下文、装技能真干活
zh.subtitle: 不再死背提示词咒语，而是精准喂背景资料（上下文工程）、给 AI 配按需翻阅的说明书（SKILL.md），让它在终端自己写代码跑测试。

en.name: Transformer & Self-Attention (How AI Reads Context)
en.oneLiner: Instead of reading word by word and forgetting the start, AI looks at the whole sentence at once and links related words together.
en.paradigmShift: Reading one word at a time and forgetting early context → looking at the whole page in parallel and connecting clues.
en.whyNow: Every modern LLM and video model still runs on this engine — knowing it explains why longer chats cost more time and memory.

zh.name: Transformer 与注意力机制（AI 怎么读懂上下文）
zh.oneLiner: 让电脑不再像老式录音机那样一个字一个字慢吞吞往后读，而是一眼扫完整段话，自动把前后关联紧密的词连起来理解。
zh.paradigmShift: 读到后面忘了前面 → 一眼看全篇，自动抓出哪个代词指代谁、哪句话最重要。
zh.whyNow: 今天所有大模型（ChatGPT、Claude、DeepSeek）全靠这套底座运转；看懂它，就明白为什么聊天记录越长、AI 越吃内存越慢。

en.name: Tokens & Embeddings (Turning Words into Numbers)
en.oneLiner: AI doesn't read letters — it chops text into small chunks (tokens) and places similar meanings close together on a giant number map (vectors).
en.paradigmShift: Exact word matching that breaks on synonyms → placing meaning on a coordinate map so 'iPhone' sits right next to 'Apple phone'.
en.whyNow: Explains why AI miscounts letters in 'strawberry', how API billing works, and how private knowledge search finds matching paragraphs.

zh.name: 分词（Token）与向量（文字怎么变成数字）
zh.oneLiner: 电脑其实不认识汉字或英文：它先把句子切成小碎块（Token），再把每个词的意思标在一张巨大的数字地图上——意思越像，靠得越近。
zh.paradigmShift: 死板对字眼，换个近义词就搜不到 → 按意思排坐标，搜「苹果手机」也能找到写着「iPhone」的段落。
zh.whyNow: 搞懂它，你瞬间就能明白为什么 AI 数不清单词里有几个字母、为什么按 Token 算钱，以及知识库是怎么搜资料的。

en.name: Pre-Training & Scaling Laws (Feeding the Whole Internet)
en.oneLiner: By playing 'guess the next word' across trillions of web pages, models absorb grammar, code, logic, and world facts all at once.
en.paradigmShift: Training one narrow model per tiny task → training one giant general base model on massive clean text and code.
en.whyNow: Clean human internet text is mostly used up, so big labs now win through cleaner textbook data and post-training reasoning.

zh.name: 预训练与大力出奇迹法则（Scaling Laws）
zh.oneLiner: 让模型在几万亿字的网页、书籍和代码里疯狂玩「猜下一个词」游戏——显卡越多、好资料越多，模型就越聪明，而且提升幅度能提前算出来。
zh.paradigmShift: 翻译做一个小模型、分类再做一个小模型 → 先砸算力练出一个懂万事的「通才底座」。
zh.whyNow: 互联网上的优质人类文章快被喂完了，所以现在各家不再光拼谁机器多，而是拼谁的数据洗得干净、谁更会练「慢思考」。

en.name: Instruction Tuning & RLHF (Teaching Polite Conversation)
en.oneLiner: A raw pre-trained model just rambles on; sample Q&As (SFT) and human thumbs-up/down ratings (RLHF) turn it into a helpful assistant.
en.paradigmShift: Raw model that continues your question with more questions → polite assistant that follows instructions.
en.whyNow: Relying only on human ratings made models overly flattering ('sycophancy'); math and coding now use objective pass/fail grading (RLVR).

zh.name: 指令微调与人类打分对齐（SFT & RLHF）
zh.oneLiner: 刚读完网页的原始模型只会顺着你的话往下接茬；靠人工示范问答（SFT）和人类好坏打分（RLHF），才把它调教成听话礼貌的聊天助手。
zh.paradigmShift: 你问个问题，它接着给你往下编十个问题 → 听懂人话、按要求老实作答的智能助手。
zh.whyNow: 光靠人工打分有个副作用：AI 学会了顺着人类说好听的假话（讨好型幻觉）。现在数学和写代码已改用更客观的自动判题（RLVR）。

en.name: Prompting & Chain-of-Thought (Asking Clearly)
en.oneLiner: Giving clear boundaries, 2–3 concrete examples, and asking the model to 'think step by step' before answering.
en.paradigmShift: Vague one-line requests → clear rules, real input/output examples, and step-by-step scratchpads.
en.whyNow: Stop buying '1000 magic prompts' packs: modern models already think step-by-step on their own; what matters now is feeding the right background docs.

zh.name: 写好提示词与分步思考（Prompt & CoT）
zh.oneLiner: 不用改模型代码，只要把要求讲明白、附上两三个好例子，或者让它「先一步步推算再给答案」，准确率就会大幅提高。
zh.paradigmShift: 丢一句含糊不清的话让 AI 猜心意 → 把要求、参考资料和输出样板清清楚楚分开写。
zh.whyNow: 千万别再花钱买「1000 条神级提示词咒语」了！新模型自己就会慢思考，今天真正拉开差距的是给它喂对背景资料（上下文工程）。

en.name: RAG: Open-Book Exam with Private Docs
en.oneLiner: Instead of letting AI guess from memory, search your own PDFs/docs first and hand it the relevant paragraphs to answer from.
en.paradigmShift: Closed-book guessing and making up facts → open-book exam quoting your latest company documents.
en.whyNow: Chopping docs blindly by character count misses exact product codes; modern setups add keyword search + smart re-ranking.

zh.name: RAG 外挂知识库（让 AI 翻着你的资料开卷考）
zh.oneLiner: 大模型没看过你公司的内部文档，硬问就会瞎编。RAG 就是在提问时先自动去你的文档库里搜出相关几段话，塞给它照着回答。
zh.paradigmShift: 闭卷瞎猜、一本正经编造假数据 → 拿着你的最新内部文档「开卷考试」，句句标出处。
zh.whyNow: 早期那种按五百字一刀切的粗糙做法容易漏掉型号和表格，现在做项目推荐直接用升级版「关键词 + 语义混合搜索」。

en.name: LoRA Fine-Tuning & Running Models Locally
en.oneLiner: Compress open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama) to run free on your own computer with Ollama, or train lightweight LoRA add-ons on one GPU.
en.paradigmShift: Renting 64 expensive cloud GPUs to customize a model → training a tiny plug-in adapter on one card and running offline.
en.whyNow: Teaching a fast 7B–14B open model using examples from a big frontier model cuts API bills by 90% and keeps sensitive data local.

zh.name: LoRA 轻量微调与本地免费跑模型
zh.oneLiner: 通过模型压缩（量化）和 Ollama，在自家电脑断网免费跑 DeepSeek / 千问；或者只用一张显卡给开源模型打个专属「技能补丁」（LoRA）。
zh.paradigmShift: 改模型必须烧几十万租服务器重练 → 单张显卡几小时练个轻量补丁，敏感数据完全不用上传云端。
zh.whyNow: 先用昂贵的大模型跑通业务攒下好例子，再拿去教会免费的 8B/14B 小模型——这是企业把 AI 接口费砍掉 90% 的王牌招数。

en.name: Diffusion & Controllable AI Image Generation
en.oneLiner: Generate crisp images from noise, while using pose skeletons, depth maps (ControlNet), and reference photos to lock exact layouts.
en.paradigmShift: Rolling random text-to-image slot machines → locking exact character face, pose, lighting, and text spelling.
en.whyNow: Modern Flux and multimodal image editors finally spell words accurately and keep product/character details consistent across shots.

zh.name: 扩散模型与指哪打哪的可控画图
zh.oneLiner: 从一团雪花噪点里一步步擦出高清画面，再配合动作骨架（ControlNet）和参考图，让人物姿势、构图和长相完全听你指挥。
zh.paradigmShift: 输完文字像摇老虎机一样靠运气抽卡 → 锁死人物动作、光影角度、品牌字体与主角长相。
zh.whyNow: 新一代 Flux 和原生改图模型已经彻底治好了「画不对字、手指多一根」的老毛病，电商海报和分镜设计可以直接商用。

en.name: Structured JSON & Tool Calling (Giving AI Hands)
en.oneLiner: Force AI to reply in 100% valid JSON data formats and safely trigger real functions like checking weather, querying SQL, or sending emails.
en.paradigmShift: Praying AI formats its reply nicely so your code doesn't crash → strict guaranteed JSON fields and typed function calls.
en.whyNow: This is the bridge between 'a chatbot that only talks' and 'an assistant that actually checks orders and updates systems'.

zh.name: 固定格式输出与调用外部工具（Function Calling）
zh.oneLiner: 逼着 AI 严格按你规定的表格字段（JSON）交作业，绝不多吐一句废话；需要查库存、算账或发邮件时，自动按格式申请调用真实软件。
zh.paradigmShift: 求着 AI 别乱改格式，程序一解析就崩 → 底层强制锁死输出格式，100% 严丝合缝对接业务系统。
zh.whyNow: 这是把「光耍嘴皮子的聊天框」变成「真能帮你查数据库、改订单的干活助手」最关键的一座桥。

en.name: Fixed Workflows vs. Autonomous Agents
en.oneLiner: Know when to use a predictable step-1-2-3 pipeline (Workflow) versus letting the model freely decide its next steps (Agent).
en.paradigmShift: 2023 AutoGPT spinning in endless loops → predictable step pipelines with save-points and human approval stops.
en.whyNow: Giant 30-node drag-and-drop flowcharts are fading out; stronger 2026 models work best with a simple loop + clean SKILL.md guides.

zh.name: 固定流水线（Workflow）与自主智能体（Agent）
zh.oneLiner: 分清什么时候该用「第一步、第二步固定写死的流水线」，什么时候才放手让 AI 自己看情况决定下一步怎么走，并加上存档防死循环。
zh.paradigmShift: 放任 AI 盲目乱撞陷入死循环烧钱 → 固定流程兜底 + 关键动作停下来让人点确认。
zh.whyNow: 动辄连几十个框的复杂拖拽流程图正在退潮——模型变聪明后，「一个简单的循环 + 写清楚的 SKILL.md 说明书」反而更稳更好改。

en.name: Million-Word Context & Native Audio/Video Understanding
en.oneLiner: Drop in ten PDF reports, a whole codebase, screenshots, or an hour-long meeting recording — one model reads, sees, and hears it all.
en.paradigmShift: Tiny 3,000-word limits + messy OCR plugins → million-token cached windows + direct chart, audio, and video comprehension.
en.whyNow: Bigger windows don't mean 'dump everything blindly' — stuffing too much irrelevant text still makes AI miss details in the middle.

zh.name: 百万字超长记忆与直接看图听音（原生多模态）
zh.oneLiner: 一口气丢进去几十份 PDF 财报、整个项目代码、复杂表格截图甚至一小时会议录音，同一个模型直接看懂听懂，不用东拼西凑。
zh.paradigmShift: 超过三千字就失忆、还得外挂文字识别 → 百万字超大容量 + 图文音视频直接端到端理解。
zh.whyNow: 注意一个大坑：窗口装得下不代表「塞得越满越聪明」——无关废话塞多了，AI 照样会漏看藏在中间的关键条件。

en.name: LLM Evals: Automatic Exam Papers for Your AI App
en.oneLiner: Instead of testing 3 questions by eye and hoping for the best, build a 100-question real-world exam that grades every change automatically.
en.paradigmShift: Eyeballing 3 cherry-picked chats ('looks good to me!') → logging real user failures + automated pass/fail test suites.
en.whyNow: Changing one sentence in a prompt can fix Question A while breaking Question B — Evals let teams upgrade fast without fear.

zh.name: AI 质量评测（Evals：给你的 AI 出一套自动考卷）
zh.oneLiner: 别每次改完提示词只拿两三个问题肉眼试一下就敢上线！把真实用户常问的 100 道题做成自动考卷，每次改动 5 分钟跑出通过率。
zh.paradigmShift: 拍脑袋试三条觉得「看着还行」就上线 → 收集真实错题本 + 每次发版前自动批改验收。
zh.whyNow: 改提示词最怕「按下葫芦浮起瓢」。谁手里有一套贴合自己业务的自动错题考卷，谁才是真正专业的高薪 AI 工程师。

en.name: ComfyUI Pipelines & Controllable Video / Voice
en.oneLiner: Connect visual building blocks like Lego to lock character faces, generate start-to-end keyframe video, and sync realistic voiceovers.
en.paradigmShift: Typing one-off prompts in a web box → reusable visual workflows locking character face, camera motion, and lip-sync.
en.whyNow: Studios always nail the first and last still images in Flux/ComfyUI first, then drive smooth video motion in between.

zh.name: ComfyUI 搭积木工作流与可控视频 / 配音
zh.oneLiner: 像搭乐高积木一样把「锁死主角长相 → 画好开头结尾画面 → 让镜头动起来 → 配上真人感声音」串成一套随时复用的流水线。
zh.paradigmShift: 每次在网页输入框碰运气抽盲盒 → 锁住首尾关键画面与运镜方向，保存成团队一键复用的模板。
zh.whyNow: 「先用生图定好角色和首尾两张图，再生成中间视频」，是今天做 AI 短片、广告和电商视觉唯一不翻车的标准做法。

en.name: MCP: The Universal USB-C Plug for AI Tools
en.oneLiner: An open plug standard so databases, GitHub, Notion, and Slack connect once and work immediately across Claude, Cursor, Codex, and more.
en.paradigmShift: Writing custom connector code for every single AI app → one standard MCP plug that works everywhere.
en.whyNow: Warning for 2026: plugging in 50 MCP tools at once clogs the AI's memory — keep active tools lean and pair with SKILL.md.

zh.name: MCP 万能工具接口（AI 界的 USB-C 充电口）
zh.oneLiner: 就像手机充电线统一成 Type-C 一样：给你的数据库、飞书或 GitHub 装好一个 MCP 插头，Claude、Cursor 等各种 AI 软件插上就能直接读写数据。
zh.paradigmShift: 每换一款 AI 软件就要重新写一遍对接代码 → 做一次标准插头，所有主流 AI 工具即插即用。
zh.whyNow: 2026 实战避坑：千万别贪多一次插上几十个 MCP 工具，工具列表太长会把 AI 看晕变笨；平时只挂最核心的几个最稳。

en.name: Slow-Thinking Reasoning Models & RLVR (DeepSeek-R1 / o3)
en.oneLiner: By grading AI on math & code problems with clear right/wrong answers (RLVR), models taught themselves to draft, catch mistakes, and backtrack.
en.paradigmShift: Blurting out the first intuitive answer immediately → pausing to draft, test hypotheses, and self-correct before replying.
en.whyNow: Combining slow thinking with mid-thought tool use (searching files or running code mid-reasoning) unlocked real software debugging.

zh.name: 慢思考推理模型与自动刷题进化（DeepSeek-R1 / o3 / RLVR）
zh.oneLiner: 拿大量有标准答案的数学和编程题让 AI 自己刷，做对了自动给奖励（RLVR）——结果 AI 无师自通学会了「先打草稿、发现算错自己划掉重来」。
zh.paradigmShift: 不管题目多难都凭直觉脱口秒回 → 遇到难题先在草稿纸上反复推演检查，想通了再开口。
zh.whyNow: 现在的推理模型还能「边打草稿边查文件、跑代码验证」，这也是为什么近一年 AI 修复杂 Bug 的能力突然突飞猛进。

en.name: Vibe Coding (Building Prototypes in Plain Language)
en.oneLiner: Coined by Karpathy: describe what you want in plain words, let AI write all the code, and spin up working prototypes or personal tools in hours.
en.paradigmShift: Spending days setting up boilerplate code by hand → chatting your idea into a clickable app over a weekend.
en.whyNow: Great for quick prototypes, dangerous if you never check security or tests — serious projects now add rules and automated checks.

zh.name: Vibe Coding 动嘴写代码（快速做出小产品）
zh.oneLiner: 大神 Karpathy 带火的新玩法：不用自己死磕语法细节，直接用大白话告诉 AI 你想要什么界面和功能，一下午就能攒出能点能用的小工具。
zh.paradigmShift: 做个小网页要先学半年编程配环境 → 口述需求边看效果边改，一天跑通产品原型。
zh.whyNow: 拿来做个人小工具和演示原型爽翻天；但如果完全不看代码就上线收钱，很容易在密码安全和几千行后改不动上翻大车。

en.name: Browser & Computer-Use Agents (AI Clicking Screens)
en.oneLiner: Let AI open a real browser inside a safe sandbox, read button labels and screenshots, fill forms, and test your web pages like a human.
en.paradigmShift: Fragile automation scripts that break whenever a button moves 5 pixels → AI reading page structure and screenshots adaptively.
en.whyNow: Super handy for automatic UI testing and old internal websites without APIs — just always require human approval before paying or deleting.

zh.name: 操作电脑与浏览器的 AI（替你点网页、填表、测界面）
zh.oneLiner: 让 AI 在安全隔离的浏览器里直接看网页结构与截图，像真人一样自己移动鼠标、点击按钮、填写繁琐后台表单或检查网页有没有排版错位。
zh.paradigmShift: 网页改个按钮位置，传统按键精灵脚本就全挂 → AI 自己看懂页面文字和画面，改版也不怕。
zh.whyNow: 对付没有开放接口的老旧内部后台、或者自动验收前端网页特别省心；但凡涉及付款、发消息和删数据，务必留一步真人确认。

en.name: Hybrid & Agentic Search (Smarter Knowledge Bases)
en.oneLiner: Combine exact keyword matching + meaning vectors + smart re-ranking, and let the AI search a second or third time if the first result isn't enough.
en.paradigmShift: One-shot vector search that misses exact IDs → keyword + vector fusion + AI iteratively refining its own search queries.
en.whyNow: Big practical lesson: on code and neat docs, super-fast keyword search (ripgrep) + reading whole sections often beats complicated vector setups.

zh.name: 升级版混合搜索与多轮深挖知识库（Hybrid & Agentic RAG）
zh.oneLiner: 把「字面精确搜型号」和「按意思模糊搜」合二为一，如果第一把没找全，还允许 AI 像真人查资料一样自己换个关键词再往下深挖。
zh.paradigmShift: 只搜一次向量，遇到专有名词和跨文档对比就抓瞎 → 关键词+向量双保险 + AI 自己多翻几次交叉核对。
zh.whyNow: 一线实战大实话：如果你的资料本身目录很清晰（比如代码库或规章手册），直接让 AI 搜关键词再翻对应章节，比瞎折腾复杂向量库还准！

en.name: Context Engineering (Feeding AI Just What It Needs)
en.oneLiner: AI gets confused when chats drag on with junk logs ('context rot'). Context engineering means feeding just the right facts at the right step and summarizing old noise.
en.paradigmShift: Obsessing over clever prompt wording → curating clean background info, trimming noisy logs, and summarizing progress.
en.whyNow: Named by Karpathy and Anthropic as the real successor to Prompt Engineering — clean context is #1 for reliable long tasks.

zh.name: 上下文工程（Context Engineering：别把 AI 的脑子塞成垃圾场）
zh.oneLiner: 跟 AI 聊上几十轮、塞满报错日志和无用文档后，它会明显变笨漏重点。上下文工程就是：每一步只挑最关键的信息喂给它，过期的废话及时打包压缩。
zh.paradigmShift: 死抠一两句提示词怎么措辞 → 像收拾桌面一样，按需取资料、定期清理历史噪音、长任务记好阶段小结。
zh.whyNow: 被 Karpathy 和 Anthropic 公认为「提示词工程的真正接班人」——今天 AI 干活稳不稳，八成取决于你喂给它的上下文干不干净。

en.name: Terminal Coding Agents & AGENTS.md Rules (Claude Code / Codex)
en.oneLiner: Instead of just auto-completing one line, terminal agents read your whole project, plan changes, edit multiple files, run tests, and fix their own bugs.
en.paradigmShift: Tab-completing a few lines inside one file → 'read repo → plan → edit → run tests → self-fix' loops guided by AGENTS.md.
en.whyNow: The secret isn't switching editors every week — it's giving your AI fast automated test checks and a clear 1-page AGENTS.md rulebook.

zh.name: 终端自动编程与项目家规（Claude Code / Codex / AGENTS.md）
zh.oneLiner: 不止是帮你补全下一行代码：Claude Code、Codex 这类工具能自己读懂整个项目，先列修改计划、跨十几个文件改代码、自己跑测试，报错了再自己修好。
zh.paradigmShift: 写半截代码等 AI 补下半句 → 照着 AGENTS.md 项目家规，走完「看代码 → 定方案 → 动手改 → 跑测试验收」全套闭环。
zh.whyNow: 提效秘诀根本不是天天换编辑器，而是给项目配好一秒跑完的自动检查命令，让 AI 有把尺子能自己发现错、自己改对。

en.name: Agent Skills (SKILL.md) & Helper Subagents
en.oneLiner: Pack repeatable know-how into neat SKILL.md folders that load only when needed, and send messy research chores to separate helper subagents.
en.paradigmShift: Stuffing 40,000 words of instructions upfront → reading a tiny table of contents first, opening the right SKILL.md manual on demand.
en.whyNow: The biggest 2026 breakthrough: one general agent + reusable SKILL.md folders works across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini.

zh.name: 按需技能包（SKILL.md）与分头干活的子助手（Subagents）
zh.oneLiner: 把你的专业干活套路写成一本本 SKILL.md 小册子，AI 平时只看目录、用到哪本翻哪本；遇到翻几十个文件的大活，派独立「子助手」分头查完只汇报重点。
zh.paradigmShift: 一上来塞几万字说明书把 AI 撑晕 → 先看两行目录按需翻书 + 脏活累活派小助手去独立房间干完交摘要。
zh.whyNow: 这是 2026 最火的实战用法：写好一套 SKILL.md 技能文件夹，在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 里到处都能直接复用。

en.name: 3D World Models & Robot Brains (Spatial AI & VLA)
en.oneLiner: Teaching AI real 3D space, gravity, and cause-and-effect so virtual worlds stay consistent when you walk around and robots can grasp real objects.
en.paradigmShift: Text/video AI where rooms change shape when the camera turns → persistent 3D physics worlds and Vision-Language-Action robots.
en.whyNow: The next big frontier beyond text chat: interactive game worlds, virtual filmmaking, and general-purpose home/factory robots.

zh.name: 3D 世界模型与机器人大脑（空间智能与具身智能）
zh.oneLiner: 光读文字的 AI 不懂真实的重力、遮挡和空间。世界模型让 AI 真正理解三维物理常识——镜头转一圈回来房间不会变样，还能指挥机器人稳稳叠衣服拿杯子。
zh.paradigmShift: 只会预测文字或画面一转头背景就穿帮 → 懂三维空间物理规律的可交互世界与手眼协调机器人（VLA）。
zh.whyNow: 这是聊天大模型之后的下一个大浪潮：李飞飞、杨立昆和各大实验室都在押注，将彻底改变游戏生成、影视拍摄与家用/工厂机器人。
